translations.web: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
translations.bsb: Does it delight the Almighty that you are righteous? Does He profit if your ways are blameless?
translations.kjv: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
translations.asv: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
